name: len-skips-expired
prompt: There is an inconsistency in session.go: Store.Len reports every session in the map, including ones that have already expired but have not been read yet, while Get would report those same sessions as not found. Change Len to count only sessions that are still live (now minus LastSeen not exceeding ttl), and to drop expired entries it encounters while counting, exactly matching what Get would report. Len must stay safe for concurrent use.
